The program was rejected only because the word "input" appears in a comment. I also cleaned up two dead expressions. I raised gm/Id on the PMOS output device and on the NMOS current sinks so that the predicted output swing clears 1.52 V. I lengthened the differential-pair devices to lower 1/f noise.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Program was rejected because 'input' appears in a comment. Cleaned up dead expressions and raised gm/Id of M7/M8 so predicted swing clears 1.52 V. Longer L1 for flicker noise. Two-stage Miller with nulling resistor fits the power budget (~277 uW)."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.4, 2.0),
    "Itail": (24e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "I7":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 140e-6),
    "gmid7": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidn": (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "fzr":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    # differential pair (source near 0.3 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It/2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load and PMOS CS second stage share gm/Id and L -> equal Vgs, zero systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], It/2, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: reference diode, tail, output sink share gm/Id and L
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gbw = m1.gm/(2*PI*Cc)
    Rz = 1.0/m7.gm + 1.0/(2*PI*p["fzr"]*gbw*Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # polarity: vinp up -> o1 down -> vout up
    A1 = m1.gm/(m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm*Cc/(C1*C2 + Cc*(C1 + C2))/(2*PI)
    fz = 1.0/(2*PI*Cc*max(Rz - 1.0/m7.gm, 1.0))
    p3 = 1.0/(2*PI*Rz*C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/p3))
    power = 1.8*(iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It/Cc, I7/(cl + Cc))
    swing = 1.8 - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    cmrr = db(A1*2*m3.gm/m5.gds)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A1*A2), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
        "slew": slew, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, 100),
        "psrr_db": db(A1*A2) - 3, "settle": 4.6/(2*PI*gbw) + 0.5/slew,
    }
```
